none: PAS NLM-C805E7: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably Providentiae Caess issue of 324-330, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust helmeted or laureate cuirassed left. Reverse description: Camp gate with two turrets, star above. Reverse inscription: [PROVIDENTIAE CAESS]. Diameter: 18.0mm, Weight: 1.61gms, die axis: 6
